text:
Samir: Quick heads-up — BenchDay Blitz with Nimbus tomorrow 09:00 PT. Focus: perf/W sweep + kernel micro-tuning. Need confirmers for telemetry, firewall rules, and a regression gate.

Marta: I'm in. I'll bring telemetry dashboards, baseline graphs, and alert thresholds.

Kai: Can we get the SI to run our 8k-token throughput script during the window? ping @NimbusEng for node allocation.

NimbusEng: (Nimbus) We'll have 2 nodes available. Need the exact kernel build and any special rt knobs you want.

EVA: Use kernel build rtx-2026-03-15-kt1. Primary knobs: tickless=1, nohz_full=0-3, isolcpus=2-3. Also run with our quantized runtime flag: --quant-mode=8bit.

Samir: Also please run a KV-cache warmup before measuring — otherwise perf/W looks weird on the first 30s.

Marta: I'll add a smoke step. Example command for the smoke run:
```
./run_bench --profile perfw --batch=8 --seq=2048 --warmup=60
```

Kai: Firewall/ops checklist: partner needs TCP 9000 (inference), TCP 9100 (node exporter), UDP 161 for IPMI. Ops-bot, can you open those?

ops-bot: Created request SR-1234 and opened ports 9000/9100/161 for 2 nodes in nimbus-us-west-2. ETA: 45m. :white_check_mark:

NimbusEng: For power telemetry we'll provide IPMI samples every 5s. Do you want raw watts or normalized values?

EVA: Send raw watts + timestamps. We'll normalize to W/token in post. CSV headers we expect: timestamp,node_id,power_w,tokens,latency_ms

Samir: Regression gate: fail the run if perf/W drops >6% vs baseline for the 95th percentile. Who can own the check?

Marta: I can own the regression gate. I'll add a tiny eval harness that compares this run to the current baseline and posts a PASS/FAIL to the run summary.

Kai: One more ask — please capture kernel dmesg and perf top for the top 60s of the steady-state window and attach to the run artifacts.

NimbusEng: Will attach dmesg + perf outputs. We'll also provide a short README with machine inventory and fan curves.

Samir: Timeline recap: prep today (configs + runbook updates), dry-run tonight 22:00 PT, full run tomorrow 09:00–12:00 PT.

Marta: I'll push the dashboard links and the harness to the run artifacts by EOD.

EVA: Adding the kernel config snippet for ops:
```
# kernel params for BenchDay Blitz
nohz_full=0-3 isolcpus=2-3 rcu_nocbs=2-3 quiet
sysctl -w vm.swappiness=1
export REDWOOD_TELEM=1
```

Samir: Thanks — tagging follow-ups: @Marta please add the regression thresholds to the runbook; @NimbusEng please confirm node hostnames. :rocket: 

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: BenchDay Blitz run tomorrow 08:45 PT (15m prior). Calendar invite sent to participants. :bell:

NimbusEng: Confirmed hostnames: nimbus-a01, nimbus-a02. We'll be ready for the dry-run tonight.

Kai: Great. I'll be on standby for ops and quick fixes. :thumbsup:

Marta: Copy — will post final checklist in this thread after the dry-run.
